entry.description: Number of the entry in `entries` (1 = first) the reaction is printed in

part.description: null when the whole cell belongs to this reaction; else the part of the cell text that does, copied exactly

results.description: The result cells of this reaction

variant.description: Key of the template variant this reaction runs: the one whose label is printed with its results or heads its group of entries, or the one a rule printed in the figure assigns to it (say so in notes); null without a label or rule

footnote_markers.description: Markers printed in the entry (on the compound number or on its results) that apply to this reaction; never those of the title or of the general reaction

distinguishing.description: Every reaction of an entry that reports more than one: what sets it apart, as printed ('[B]', '60 °C', 'on a larger scale', 'Cl'); null for an entry that reports one reaction

column.description: Key of a participant or variable field

part.description: The part of that cell's text that is this reaction's own, copied exactly

cells.description: Only when the entry reports several reactions that differ in a variable value (or a compound) printed together in one field ('Br / Cl'): this reaction's part of that cell. Empty otherwise

reactions.description: Every reaction of the figure in entry order: one per entry, unless an entry reports several experiments

notes.description: Why an entry was split, how a variant was assigned to an entry that prints no label, or what is unusual about it; nothing for plain entries

issues.description: Doubts a reviewer should look at
